newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Five firms win Philippine corn import contracts.
newsitem.headline: Five firms win Philippine corn import contracts.

text.p: Five companies won six corn import contracts from the Philippines, officials from the Philippines' National Food Authority said.

The officials said Glencore Far East Philippines AG, a subsidiary of Glencore International AG, won two contracts of 25,000 tonnes of U.S. yellow corn No. 2 each at $159.98 per tonne, cash-and-freight (C&F), and $157.75 tonne C&F.
The first shipment will leave the U.S. pacific northwest on December 1, while the second will leave the same port on November 23.
Both will arrive at the Bataan grains terminal.
Continental Grains won a contract at $164.88 per tonne C&F with a delivery date of November 16. The shipment is expected to arrive at the Bataan terminal, northwest of Manila.
Louis Dreyfus won a contract at $165.39 per tonne C&F. Delivery date is on November 23 and will arrive at the South Harbour of Manila, the officials said.
Mitsui & Co Ltd won the fifth contract at $155.35 per tonne C&F. Delivery date is on December 14. The Bataan terminal will receive the shipment.
Kanematsu won the sixth contract at $163.30 per tonne C&F. It will arrive at Manila's South Harbour.
